title: Snapshot identity — Snapshot Navigator
description: Snapshots get immutable ids (timestamps or hashes) so 'as of March 1' is precise. Identity makes snapshots citable. Names beat 'the old version'.
demo:
# Snapshot navigation: diff two snapshots, list added/removed/changed records.
snap_a = {r["id"]: r for r in [{'id': 'r1', 'v': 1}]}
snap_b = {r["id"]: r for r in [{'id': 'r1', 'v': 2}, {'id': 'r2', 'v': 1}]}
added = [i for i in snap_b if i not in snap_a]
removed = [i for i in snap_a if i not in snap_b]
changed = [i for i in snap_a if i in snap_b and snap_a[i] != snap_b[i]]
print("added:", added or "none")
print("removed:", removed or "none")
print("changed:", changed or "none")
for i in changed:
    print(f"  {i}: {snap_a[i]} -> {snap_b[i]}")
provenance: Public methodology — standard computer-science technique documented in the technical literature; fact-checked 2026-10-21.
